measurements.text: The project has established a rigorous testing framework to evaluate the performance of Qwen3 8B models under various quantization and optimization scenarios. The setup includes a native Windows development environment with CUDA, CMake, and Ninja, ensuring compatibility with the RTX 4050 GPU. The tests focus on both correctness and performance, using a custom harness to isolate and benchmark the fused feed-forward operation of the Q4_K kernel. This approach allows for precise measurement of kernel latency and ensures that any optimizations are validated against a known baseline. The results from the initial runs show that the stock fused kernel performs well, with minimal latency and high
